audit.whatIsWrong: The page is labelled FAVOURED at 4/10 difficulty, but the win rate is 43.14% over 102 games — a clearly losing matchup.
audit.why: diff, diffRating and tone are enum fields and apply cleanly. A page that tells you a 43% matchup is favoured sets the wrong plan from the loading screen onward.
audit.corrected: diff FAVOURED -> TRICKY, diffRating 4/10 -> 6/10, tone recoloured to the TRICKY orange, and the two prose fields that quote the rating updated to match.

audit.why: Kled owns 1-2, even at 3, Yi takes 4-5 through first item, Kled reclaims at 2+. Chart matches the packet and full/content agree row for row.
audit.corrected: No change to the level chart.

audit.whatIsWrong: Chaaaaarge is described as giving Kled a remount, in spikes[1].text, wants.foe[2] and content.late.
audit.why: Riot's text for R is a charge to a location leaving a speed trail and granting a SHIELD, with Skaarl ramming the first champion hit. Remounting comes from the passive — Kled restores Skaarl's courage by fighting enemies and remounts at maximum courage. The distinction changes the plan: you deny the remount by disengaging, not by dodging his ult.
audit.corrected: All three rewritten around courage-from-fighting, with R's 140/125/110s cooldown and its shield stated.

audit.whatIsWrong: Violent Tendencies is never identified as an auto-attack reset, and Bear Trap on a Rope's slow is not distinguished from its pull.
audit.why: W grants massive attack speed for four attacks with a bigger fourth — the burst tell is the wind-up, not the cast. Q both slows and, if the shackle holds, yanks you in; Highlander's slow immunity answers the slow half.
audit.corrected: report[5].t rewritten with the auto-reset tell and the correct target for Highlander's slow immunity.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldown numbers on the two abilities the whole lane is timed around.
audit.why: Bear Trap on a Rope is 11s at rank 1 falling to 7s; Chaaaaarge is 140s at rank 1. Those numbers decide how long your step-up window actually lasts.

audit.whatIsWrong: Dismounted Kled's Q becomes Pocket Pistol, a ranged blast that knocks Kled backwards and restores courage — never mentioned anywhere on the page.
audit.why: It changes how you chase an off-Skaarl Kled: he has a self-knockback disengage that also feeds his remount, so trading with him on foot is not free.
audit.corrected: Recorded here; I did not force it into a field, because every candidate field was already at its length ceiling and the edit would have been rejected. Flagging for the next pass.

edits.before: It rates a 4/10 — FAVOURED but not free — because Kled genuinely owns the early levels and can deny your scaling with repeated Q-pull trades and remounts. The difficulty is patience: the lane is hard to throw only if you respect levels 1-3 and don't gift him the snowball before your items come online.
edits.after: It rates a 6/10 and the win rate agrees at 43.14% — Kled owns the early levels and denies your scaling with repeated Q-pull trades and remounts. The difficulty is patience: there is a real mid-game window, but only if you respect levels 1-3 and never gift him the snowball first.

edits.before: Track Bear Trap on a Rope (Q) above all — it's his engage and his only hard initiation onto you. When his Q is down he has no way to force you, so that's your window to step up, last-hit freely, or all-in. Secondarily watch his remount timer (Skaarl returning) and Chaaaaarge (R) post-6.
edits.after: Track Bear Trap on a Rope (Q) above all — 11s at rank 1 and his only hard initiation. With Q down he cannot force you, so that's your window to step up, last-hit freely, or all-in. Then watch his courage bar for the remount and Chaaaaarge (R) on 140s at rank 1 after level 6.

edits.before: Alpha Strike's untargetability dodges his Chaaaaarge (R) engage and his poke if you time it on his commit; Wuju Style's true damage ignores any armor Kled itemizes; Meditate out-sustains his between-window poke but NOT a full mounted all-in; Highlander's slow immunity beats his kite so you stick for the kill.
edits.after: Alpha Strike's untargetability dodges the Chaaaaarge (R) ram if you time it on his commit; Wuju Style's true damage ignores any armour he itemizes; Violent Tendencies (W) is an auto-attack reset, so the wind-up and not the cast is your cue to step out; Highlander's slow immunity cancels the Bear Trap slow so you stick for the kill.

edits.before: FAVOURED, 4/10 difficulty — Kled bullies the early levels but Master Yi out-scales and out-DPSes him from first item onward; respect levels 1-3, hit your spike, and close before his late-game scaling reclaims the lane.
edits.after: TRICKY, 6/10 difficulty (43.14% WR) — Kled bullies the early levels and most of these games never recover; respect levels 1-3, hit your first-item spike, and close it out before his remount scaling reclaims the lane.

edits.before: Kled's Chaaaaarge ult gives him a re-mount and a big engage, yet by now your Wuju Style + Highlander let you win extended duels if he's off skaarl.
edits.after: Chaaaaarge is a 140s engage with a shield, not a remount — his courage does that. By 6 your Wuju Style and Highlander win extended duels if he's off Skaarl.

edits.before: Watch the re-mount: late-game Kled restores full skaarl and his Bear Trap + Chaaaaarge burst can chunk you before you can Meditate, so respect every re-engage.
edits.after: Watch the remount: courage from fighting brings Skaarl back, and Bear Trap into a 110s Chaaaaarge can chunk you before Meditate, so respect every re-engage.

edits.before: Re-mount off his ult to re-engage and burst you
edits.after: Build courage off you to remount and re-engage

notes: Reclassified this matchup: it was labelled FAVOURED at 4/10 while sitting at 43.14% over 102 games. Changed to TRICKY 6/10 with the matching tone, and updated the two prose fields that quote the rating. Also corrected a mechanical error repeated three times — Chaaaaarge does not remount Kled; courage gained from fighting does. Pocket Pistol (dismounted Q) is absent from the page entirely and could not be added without breaking a length band.
